description: Block merging per area and DB, max_gap, the PDU span, timers and counters (D-051).

vectors.description: Items within max_gap (16) merge; the gap is read and ignored.
Areas and DBs never share a block; blocks sorted by area then DB.
Overlapping items and bits share a block.
A PDU of 480 carries 462 bytes: the tags split at the span.
An item larger than the span is invalid.

invalid.big: s7 address 'DB1,B0.470' (string): needs 470 bytes in one request, more than the 462 a PDU of 480 bytes carries (max_pdu=480)

vectors.description: An item of exactly 462 bytes fits.
Timers and counters merge in elements (2 bytes each); max_gap halves.
One address under many names is read once.
The plan does not depend on the order of the tags.
